slither-extended.json.location: AGIJobManager._settleValidators(AGIJobManager.Job,bool,uint256,uint256,uint256) (contracts/AGIJobManager.sol#1365-1420) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
slither-extended.json.rationale: The slash is intentionally floored for each incorrect validator. Multiplying that per-validator slash by the incorrect-validator count exactly equals the sum withheld from individual bonds; multiplying before flooring could allocate more than was withheld. Remaining USDC is routed to the winning party.

slither-reentrancy.json.rationale: These are best-effort ENS metadata events after configured ENS/resolver calls or an onlySelf dispatch. Metadata entry points require onlyOwner, onlyJobManager, or onlySelf; an ordinary external callback cannot assume those roles. Consumers must use manager job state and transaction/log order for settlement truth. The real-ENS fork exercises grants, actor writes and terminal revocation.

Assembly bounds each ERC165 staticcall to ERC165_GAS_LIMIT, requires at least one full return word, accepts only canonical true for ERC165/ERC721, and requires canonical false for the invalid interface. Owner-selected credential registration rejects malformed and dishonest interface responses.

Assembly decodes exactly one full return word after a 32-byte length check. Failed calls, false/noncanonical booleans and malformed nonempty returndata revert; supported no-return ERC20 calls are allowed only for contract targets. Exact incoming balance deltas reject transfer fees.

slither-all.json.rationale: This existing event ABI stores its address in log data.
